# Party at Red Rocks (Red Rocks Amphitheatre / Denver)
Primary: Private Red Rocks transportation, concert planning, venue intel, and show guides.

Current transportation product:
- Private Suburban: $399 flat rate
- Private van: $599 flat rate
- Private group transportation only; no shared shuttle seats
- Door-to-door pickup for the group
- Vehicle waits through the show for the return ride
- Red Rocks booking: /book/red-rocks-amphitheatre/private

Key pages:
- /red-rocks/concerts (Red Rocks concert schedule)
- /week/red-rocks (shows this week)
- /venues/red-rocks-amphitheatre (venue intel)
- /red-rocks/transportation (transportation planning)
- /red-rocks/parking (parking guide)
- /shows/{id} (show details + private ride planning)
- /shuttles (current private transportation offer)

Data sources used for event and artist enrichment/caching:
- SeatGeek
- Ticketmaster
- MusicBrainz
- Setlist.fm
- Last.fm

Business:
- Party at Red Rocks provides private transportation for Red Rocks concert groups.
- Current public offer is $399 Private Suburban or $599 Private Van.
- Booking is completed through the current Party at Red Rocks booking pages and embedded Rezdy booking experience.
